title: The Latest Advances in the Field of Intelligent Systems
summary: This Edited Volume, The Latest Advances in the Field of Intelligent Systems , is a collection of peer-reviewed research chapters that provide a comprehensive overview of recent developments in Artificial Intelligence. The book comprises single chapters authored by various researchers and edited by experts active in Artificial Intelligence. All chapters are complete in themselves but united under a common research study topic. This publication aims to provide a comprehensive overview of recent research by international authors in the field and to open new avenues for further development.
